patch_list: Adds a Fit/Stretch toggle to the player.
Unhides the player's speed menu and fills it out to 0.5x-2.0x.
Adds subtitle size, font and outline controls to the player.

sources.label: Kageroll
sources.author: Kageroll
patch_list: Upgrades the High offline download quality tier to 1080p and selects the single best matching video track.
Removes FLAG_SECURE from membership card and Compose dialogs to permit screenshots and disables Android 14+ screen capture detection in the Arc reader.
Cycles video aspect modes (Fit, Zoom, Fill) on pinch and remembers the selected mode across sessions.
Customizes ASS subtitle font scale, bottom margin, outline, shadow, and colors, and adapts subtitle viewport margins to the active video aspect ratio and resize mode.
Automatically skips intros, recaps, credits, previews, or promos in the video player.
Customizes the delay before player controls automatically hide, or disables auto-hiding.

Disables background broadcast receivers, schedulers, widget polling, Firebase sessions initialization and service binding, and DataTransport JobScheduler tasks to eliminate background wakeups and idle battery drain.

Blocks Segment initialization, Mux events, advertising ID lookup, Firebase Analytics pre-init, Crashlytics NDK native loading, Braze session and push flush alarms, and Datadog uploads; disables Firebase Analytics after consent updates, den…
Hides promotional cards, vertical promo rows, floating action buttons, and show-page promo banners.
Hides the maturity rating overlay when starting or resuming playback.
Replaces the preset quality tiers with manual per-resolution selection and Auto.
Unhides the player's speed menu and expands playback speed options up to 4.0x.
Enables pinch-to-zoom, double-tap-to-seek, and vertical swipe gestures for brightness and volume.
Overrides initial default values for audio language, subtitles, autoplay, cellular streaming, closed captions, audio description, and playback speed.
Routes token acquisition and refresh through your SOCKS proxy, with optional proxy authentication.
Allows tapping the player timestamp or duration to toggle between elapsed time and remaining time (-MM:SS).
Adds a screen lock toggle to the player toolbar and locks orientation against accidental rotation.
Customizes the double-tap and rewind/fast-forward seek interval in the video player.
Skips the animated startup splash video and its audio focus request, and skips cold-start checkout WebView preloading.
Forces Google Engage, Continue Watching, Datadog, and OneTrust CMP background workers to return success immediately without performing network requests, disk I/O, or image prefetching.
Suppresses Braze in-app message overlays, Play in-app review prompts, Play in-app update prompts, and the startup notification permission prompt.
Customizes how many seconds before the end of an episode the Up Next banner appears.
